display_title: Are you just going to study?
description:
*"Teacher, if I do well on that essay test, let me touch your breasts."* 

On the first snowy winter of the new year, Joo Ji-Soo, a delinquent repeat student, gets rejected from all the universities he applied to. She was excited about going to a lesbian bar and having fun with big-breasted girls as soon as she finished his entrance exams, but she has no choice but to return home because of his overbearing mother. And then she meets a new private tutor that his mother has hired. As soon as she sees the pretty tutor with big breasts, Ji-Soo falls in love at first sight, and she expresses her feelings in her own way by whining and embarrassing the teacher...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).*
